label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Two dialogs (a country welcome box and a privacy box) were open at once. Focus sat in the welcome box, and jumping or tabbing to Reject All did not work until I pressed Escape.
A newsletter popup offering a discount opened by itself when I moved to a product, which interrupted me. After I closed it, a Get 20% Off button and a teaser button stayed at the top of the page.
The hero carousel changed slides on its own (slide 1, 2, 3, 4), so the page content kept changing while I was reading it.
Pressing Enter on a product link only showed a hidden Quick View button instead of opening the product. I needed a second step to reach the product, which was not obvious.

element.name: Pique Fleece [name] Hoodie, Salt. $138. Press Enter to show quick view

findings.problem: In the product dialog, the first read showed only a Close button, and the details appeared later. Product photos are named with raw file names such as V2115SAL_FA26_M_LAYERS_DETAIL_12.jpg, and there is an unnamed button.
After Continue to Checkout was pressed, the button became disabled and nothing announced that checkout was loading. I had to read the page again to find the checkout page.
